hero_kpi_rationale: GSV (Gross Services Volume) is the Hero KPI because it represents the total value of services transacted on Upwork's platforms, which is a key indicator of the company's growth and health. At $4.0 billion in 2025, it reflects overall economic activity and marketplace traction.

kpis.name: Gross Services Volume
kpis.explanation: Total value of services transacted on Upwork's platforms
kpis.description: GSV is a key indicator of the company's growth and health. Metric tracked annually by company analysts, with historical data over the past 3 years.

kpis.name: Marketplace revenue
kpis.description: Marketplace revenue is a key indicator of monetization and company health

kpis.name: Marketplace take rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of marketplace revenue relative to marketplace GSV
kpis.description: Take rate measures the correlation between marketplace revenue and marketplace GSV, a key monetization indicator

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Adjusted EBITDA before Upwork non-GAAP items
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA is a key indicator of the company's profitability and operational efficiency

kpis.name: Active clients
kpis.explanation: Number of clients with spending activity over the past 12 months
kpis.description: Number of active clients is a key indicator of the client base and marketplace reach

kpis.name: GSV per active client
kpis.explanation: Average gross services value per active client
kpis.description: GSV per active client is a key indicator of monetization efficiency and client engagement depth

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.

risks.title: Community growth dependency
risks.score_rationale: Growth depends heavily on the ability to attract and retain a community of talent and clients. Inability to maintain or develop the active client community effectively could have a negative impact on business, operating results, and financial position.

risks.title: Payment and fraud risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to payment and fraud risks that could have a significant negative impact on the business and platform reputation.

risks.title: Dependence on banking and payment partners
risks.score_rationale: The company depends heavily on its banking and payment partners to provide services. Inability to maintain these relationships on favorable terms could have a significant negative impact on the business.

risks.title: Security and privacy risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to risks related to security breaches, hacking attacks, phishing attacks, ransomware, and privacy incidents that could compromise the perceived security of the platforms.

risks.title: Intense competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive market with numerous competitors offering similar services. Loss of market share could adversely affect the business, operating results, and financial position.

risks.title: Regulatory compliance
risks.score_rationale: The business is subject to complex and extensive government regulations. Non-compliance could result in sanctions and operational restrictions.

risks.title: Reputation management
risks.score_rationale: Maintaining a strong reputation is essential to attract and retain clients and talent. Reputational damage could affect the client base and company performance.

ai_positioning.summary: Upwork integrates AI as a key element of its growth strategy. The company is developing proprietary AI capabilities, notably Uma, its AI assistant, and other AI-driven features that enhance productivity for talent and clients. AI is presented as one of four strategic growth drivers, alongside marketplace monetization, enterprise expansion, and SMB offerings.
evidence: Uma, proprietary AI assistant, and other AI-driven features that enhance productivity for talent and clients across the Upwork Marketplace
advancing our AI capabilities and AI-native experiences
Global, AI-enabled talent across every on-demand work type
